logline: A wind-up lamplighter whose charging pillar has broken has exactly ninety-two turns of stored energy left, and one night to light the harbour beacon before the last ship home is wrecked on the reef. Every step costs a turn. The beacon needs a mainspring, not a match.

creative_constraints.originality: MANDATORY: original characters, original story, original designs and dialogue.
creative_constraints.copyright: No copying of copyrighted characters, stories, dialogue, scenes or distinctive designs. No look-alike references. No trademarked assets.
creative_constraints.music: Original composition or explicitly public-domain / CC-licensed material only. Provenance must be recorded per asset.
creative_constraints.asset_provenance: Every asset in 06_ASSETS and 10_AUDIO must carry a provenance record (generated / authored / license + source).

retention.rule: A compelling visual or question inside the first 8 seconds; a turn every 20-40s; no dead air longer than 6s.

target_spec.narrative_requirement: Complete beginning, middle, climax and ending. No unresolved cliffhanger.
target_spec.dialogue: none - the film is wordless by design

scene_plan.rule: The film is NEVER rendered as a single job. Every scene is independently renderable and independently re-renderable.

render_engine_candidates.notes: Primary candidate. Procedural geometry + materials, no GPU required. Requires a Blender install in the runtime.
Fallback if Blender cannot be installed. Fully CPU, deterministic, no external binaries. Lower fidelity, stylised look.

pipeline.audio_engine: ffmpeg + programmatic synthesis (no external sample libraries assumed)

environment_detected.implication: Render/mux tooling must be installed or a dependency-free fallback built before T12_FINAL_RENDER. Tracked as risk R-001 / R-002.

risks.risk: ffmpeg not present in runtime; blocks audio mux, conform and final MP4 authoring.
risks.mitigation: Attempt install at T12; if unavailable, build a minimal MP4/M4A muxer or pure-python encoder fallback. Verify before any scene render is declared final.

risks.risk: Blender not present in runtime; blocks the primary 3D engine.
risks.mitigation: Attempt install at T05; if unavailable, switch to python_software_raster fallback and re-scope visual style to a stylised look.

risks.risk: Loss of completed work through reliance on conversation memory.
risks.mitigation: Repository is the single source of truth. Checkpoint rule in AGENT_PROTOCOL.md is mandatory after every successful operation.

risks.risk: Single long fragile render job loses everything on failure.
risks.mitigation: Scene-level render checkpointing (SCENE -> PREVIEW -> QC -> FINAL RENDER -> VERIFY) per 13_RENDER/RENDER_MANIFEST.json.

naming_conventions.file_case: UPPER_SNAKE_CASE for deliverables, lower_snake_case for working files
naming_conventions.versions: _v01, _v02 ... never overwrite a locked/verified artefact; write a new version.

retry_policy.on_failure: Log to ERROR_LOG.json, classify, change approach, then retry. Never re-run an identical failed command.
retry_policy.on_exhausted: Mark BLOCKED and escalate in CHANGELOG.md; preserve all completed outputs.

checkpoint_policy.on_failure: preserve everything already completed; never restart completed work unnecessarily

completion_condition.rule: The project is COMPLETE only when FINAL/FINAL_FILM.mp4 exists AND has passed technical verification in T13. Scripts, plans and renders alone are not completion.
